description: Runs Flare's deep source scan over a local directory: committed credentials, .env handling, unsafe SQL migrations (disabled RLS, allow-all policies), unprotected route handlers, and dependency issues. Findings include file and line so they can be fixed directly. Reads the filesystem only; nothing is uploaded.

failOn.description: Severity threshold for the BLOCKING verdict. Defaults to 'critical'.

path.description: Directory to scan. Defaults to the current directory.

name: flare_scan_repo
title: Scan a local repository for committed secrets and unsafe migrations
